# Shocks, springs and bump stops

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Raise the vehicle, loosen the upper ball joint bolt, then unbolt. [t553]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Raise the vehicle and support it on stands.
2. [Partial] Loosen the upper ball joint bolt to take tension off the UCA.

_Procedure reported by [t553]._

## Tools

- Stands [t553]

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that the driver's side rear UCA bolt is often pinned by the steering shaft. [t553]
- [Partial] If a pin interferes, cut it and insert a new one from behind. [t553]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Failing to remove tension on the upper ball joint before unbolting. [t553]
